signal.title: The Stack Signal — October 8, 2026
signal.troy_commentary:
The headline today is simple. Gold got hit on the FOMC minutes, slid below **$4,100** intraday and recovered to close near **$4,158**. Silver followed and ended at **$59.43**.

Running beside that noise is the story most coverage buried. The PBOC logged record gold purchases in September. Central banks don't buy physical gold over a December meeting. They buy on decade-long bets.

For your stack, today's move changes nothing about the thesis. If you've been averaging in, it isn't a day to pause.

What to watch overnight is Treasury yields, and any report of official buying into this dip.
signal.troy_one_liner: Fed minutes hammered paper gold, but the PBOC's record physical buying tells the real story.
